description: Header file defining functions related to reftable buffers and writers, including setting hash values and writing reftable data into buffers.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets the hash value in the reftable buffer at a given index.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates a reftable writer object that writes into a string buffer with specified options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reftable reference and log records into the provided buffer according to the specified options.
